cards.ex: It's important to speak out against injustice when you see it.
cards.exUz: Adolatsizlikni ko'rganingizda, unga qarshi gapirish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga biror narsaga qarshi fikr bildirish, o'z ovozini ko'tarish.

cards.ex: We should all stand up for the rights of marginalized communities.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz chetlatilgan jamoalarning huquqlarini himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini yoki g'oyani qo'llab-quvvatlash, himoya qilish.

cards.ex: The campaign aims to raise awareness about climate change.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya iqlim o'zgarishi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Muammo haqida odamlarning bilimini va tushunchasini oshirish.

cards.ex: People fought for equal rights for decades.
cards.exUz: Odamlar teng huquqlar uchun o'nlab yillar davomida kurashdilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun harakat qilish, kurash olib borish.

cards.ex: Volunteering can really make a difference in someone's life.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilik kimningdir hayotida haqiqatan ham o'zgarish qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijobiy o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan ta'sir ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Social justice is about fairness and equality for everyone.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy adolat - bu hamma uchun adolat va tenglik.
cards.uzDef: Har bir inson uchun teng imkoniyatlar va adolatli munosabat.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to basic human rights.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson asosiy inson huquqlariga ega.
cards.uzDef: Har bir inson tug'ilganidan boshlab ega bo'lgan asosiy huquqlar.

cards.ex: We can't turn a blind eye to the suffering of others.
cards.exUz: Biz boshqalarning azobiga ko'z yuma olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsani bilib turib, e'tibor bermaslik, ko'rmaganga olish.

cards.ex: The new policy aims to level the playing field for women in the workplace.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat ish joyida ayollar uchun teng imkoniyatlar yaratishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hammaga teng imkoniyatlar yaratish, adolatsizlikni bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: Education can help break down barriers between different cultures.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim turli madaniyatlar o'rtasidagi to'siqlarni bartaraf etishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni bartaraf etish, to'siqlarni olib tashlash.

cards.ex: You have to take a stand against bullying.
cards.exUz: Siz kamsitishga qarshi turishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshi qat'iy pozitsiyani egallash, o'z fikrini bildirish.

cards.ex: The report calls for urgent action to address the housing crisis.
cards.exUz: Hisobot uy-joy inqirozini hal qilish uchun zudlik bilan harakat qilishga chaqiradi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun qandaydir harakat qilishni so'rash.

cards.ex: The country has deep-seated problems with corruption.
cards.exUz: Mamlakatda korruptsiya bilan bog'liq chuqur ildiz otgan muammolar mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan va o'zgartirish qiyin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The environmental movement started as a grassroots movement.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit harakati ommaviy harakat sifatida boshlangan.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamlar tomonidan tashkil etilgan va boshlangan harakat.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all students.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha talabalar uchun teng imkoniyatlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun teng sharoit va imkoniyatlar yaratilgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Activists are pushing for changes in the law.
cards.exUz: Faollar qonunchilikka o'zgartirishlar kiritishga intilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishlar qilish uchun faol harakat qilish, lobbi qilish.

cards.ex: Children from low-income families are at risk of falling behind in school.
cards.exUz: Kam daromadli oilalardan bo'lgan bolalar maktabda orqada qolish xavfi ostida.
cards.uzDef: Biror yomon narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The government is trying to close the gap between rich and poor.
cards.exUz: Hukumat boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi farqni yo'qotishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ikki guruh o'rtasidagi farqni kamaytirish, tenglashtirish.

cards.ex: Education is key to social mobility.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim ijtimoiy harakatlanishning kalitidir.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy ahvolining o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: Systemic racism affects every aspect of society.
cards.exUz: Tizimli irqchilik jamiyatning har bir jabhasiga ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning tuzilishi va siyosatida mavjud bo'lgan irqchilik.

cards.ex: The wage gap between men and women is still a problem.
cards.exUz: Erkaklar va ayollar o'rtasidagi ish haqi farqi hanuzgacha muammo.
cards.uzDef: Erkaklar va ayollar yoki turli irqiy guruhlar o'rtasidagi ish haqi farqi.

cards.ex: There's a shortage of affordable housing in many cities.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina shaharlarda arzon uy-joylar yetishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Aholi uchun to'lashga qulay bo'lgan uy-joy.

cards.ex: Many people struggle to afford basic necessities.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar asosiy ehtiyojlarni qondirish uchun kurashadilar.
cards.uzDef: Hayot uchun zarur bo'lgan narsalar, masalan, oziq-ovqat va uy-joy.

cards.ex: The stress of poverty can take its toll on your health.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlikning stressi sizning sog'lig'ingizga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yomon ta'sir ko'rsatish, salbiy oqibatlarga olib kelish.

cards.ex: Trying to change the system is an uphill battle.
cards.exUz: Tizimni o'zgartirishga urinish - bu qiyin kurash.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarga to'la va erishish qiyin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Victim blaming is never acceptable.
cards.exUz: Jabrlanuvchini ayblash hech qachon qabul qilinishi mumkin emas.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat qurbonini sodir bo'lgan voqea uchun ayblash.

cards.ex: We need to hold politicians accountable for their actions.
cards.exUz: Biz siyosatchilarni o'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilgan odamni javobgarlikka tortish.

cards.ex: Education can help break the cycle of poverty.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim qashshoqlik doirasini buzishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy holatni yoki naqshni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves equal opportunity in life.
cards.exUz: Hayotda hamma teng imkoniyatga loyiq.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun teng imkoniyatlar, irqi, jinsi yoki boshqa omillaridan qat'i nazar.

cards.ex: The organization gives voice to marginalized communities.
cards.exUz: Tashkilot chetlatilgan jamoalarga ovoz beradi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda eshitilmaydigan odamlarga o'z fikrlarini bildirish imkoniyatini berish.
